visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are positioned in a bright indoor room. The central figure stands atop a white swivel chair, her arms gracefully curved overhead in a balletic pose. To her left, another woman in a pink cardigan holds a black chair base as if it were a prop. On the right, a third woman wearing a beanie and glasses stands ready. The background features a desk with a computer monitor, shelves filled with items, and a window with blinds. (2) As the central woman begins to spin slowly on the rotating chair, the others move in coordination. The woman on the left rotates her handheld prop to mimic a mechanical movement. The scene is captured in a single continuous eye-level shot, emphasizing the rhythmic, synchronized actions of the group, which resembles a living music box. The lighting remains bright and even across the domestic setting throughout the performance.
